newsitem.title: USA: Texas jury sentences mother to death.
newsitem.headline: Texas jury sentences mother to death.

text.p: A Texas jury on Tuesday sentenced a Dallas mother to die by lethal injection for the stabbing death of her five-year-old son.

Darlie Routier, 27, was convicted on Saturday of capital murder in the killing of her son, Damon, and still faces a murder charge for the death of another son, Devon, aged 6. The boys were stabbed to death on June 6 with a butcher's knife while they slept in their home in Rowlett, a suburb of Dallas.
The jury said its decision that Routier must die was a unanimous one, reached after about four hours of deliberation. All death penalty cases in Texas are automatically appealed.
In arguments on Tuesday, prosecutors urged the jury of seven women and four men to sentence Routier to death because they said she was a continuing threat to society.
But defense attorneys pleaded for a life sentence, which in Texas is the only alternative to the death penalty for a conviction of capital murder.
Routier testified earlier in the trial that an intruder killed the boys and attacked her, but police said they found no evidence of that.
